topic: A doll in an antique shop is never in the same place two mornings in a row.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Doll That Never Stayed

shots.narration: Every morning, that doll was closer to the shop's door.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated Pakistani haveli courtyard at night, brass lantern between bashir and saad, no writing anywhere.
shots.action: bashir points toward the closed courtyard door.
shots.mood: Amber lantern glow, blue moonlight, deep doorway shadows.

shots.narration: I watched that antique shop for three nights, Saad.
shots.scene: Haveli courtyard, bashir in brown woollen shawl and white cap, saad in dark green hoodie beside the lantern.
shots.mood: Quiet night fog, solemn expression, warm light against cold darkness.

shots.narration: [whispers] The first morning, it sat on the highest shelf.
shots.scene: Story setting: old Pakistani antique shop before sunrise, unmarked brass pots, wooden shelves, small porcelain doll in a faded blue dress.
shots.action: bashir lifts his brass lantern toward the doll on the highest shelf.
shots.mood: Dusty blue dawn, long shelf shadows, faint amber reflections.

shots.narration: The next morning, I found it on the counter.
shots.scene: Same antique shop at dawn, highest shelf empty, blue-dressed porcelain doll seated on the wooden counter nearer the exit.
shots.mood: Cold dawn haze, still objects, doll eyes catching lantern light.

shots.narration: So I locked it inside a glass cabinet.
shots.scene: Antique shop at night, porcelain doll inside a glass cabinet, plain metal lock without markings.
shots.mood: Narrow lantern glow, black corners, sharp glass reflections.

shots.narration: [surprised] By dawn, it waited outside, beside the locked cabinet.
shots.scene: Shop at blue dawn, cabinet visibly empty and padlocked, porcelain doll sitting on the floor beside it.
shots.mood: Pale light, heavy silence, unnaturally neat doll posture.

shots.narration: That night, I surrounded it with flour.
shots.scene: Antique shop floor near the entrance, seated porcelain doll inside a nearly complete white flour circle.
shots.action: bashir pours the final stretch of the flour circle.
shots.mood: Low amber illumination, dark wooden floor, enclosing shadows.

shots.narration: I watched from the doorway until my lantern flickered.
shots.scene: Interior shop doorway at midnight, bashir facing the doll within its flour circle, brass lantern beside his face.
shots.action: The lantern flame shrinks to a tiny blue point.
shots.mood: Near darkness, looming shelves, thin moonlight across flour.

shots.narration: [whispers] When the light returned, the circle was empty.
shots.scene: Same shop floor, brightened lantern light revealing an empty, perfectly intact flour circle.
shots.action: bashir lowers his lantern toward the empty circle.
shots.mood: Stark amber light, undisturbed white flour, surrounding blackness.

shots.narration: No footprints. No broken flour. Then my shawl tightened.
shots.scene: Close view of bashir at the shop doorway, empty flour circle beyond him, brown shawl drawn taut over one shoulder.
shots.action: A small fold of bashir's shawl pulls upward behind his shoulder.
shots.mood: Claustrophobic framing, trembling lantern reflections, concealed darkness behind

shots.narration: It was on my shoulder, facing the locked door.
shots.scene: Tight vertical close-up of bashir, porcelain doll perched on his shoulder with tiny hands caught in his shawl, locked shop door behind.
shots.action: The doll slowly turns its porcelain face toward bashir.
shots.mood: Wide frightened eyes, hard lantern underlight, immense doll shadow on the door.

shots.narration: [sighs] Tomorrow, I'll explain what followed me from the railway station.
shots.scene: Return to the haveli courtyard, bashir and saad beside the brass lantern, small unmarked wooden toy train in bashir's hand.
shots.action: bashir places the wooden train between them.
shots.mood: Uneasy lantern warmth, blue courtyard fog, dark passage behind the listeners.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow, Bashir reveals what followed him home from the railway station.
episode.description: By his lantern, Bashir Chacha tells Saad about an antique shop where one doll changed places every morning. Locking it away only brought it closer. A fictional spooky story from Midnight Watch.
